findings.trigger: Open Browser with a closable tab and navigate the tablist or close control by keyboard.
findings.actual: A div with role=tab contains a nested close button while also handling Enter, Space, Arrow, Home, and End. This creates conflicting interactive semantics for keyboard and assistive technology users.
findings.expected: Keep the tab as one tab-stop and expose the close action as a separate sibling control, with a coherent tablist/tabpanel relationship.
findings.smallestFix: Split each tab item into a role=tab button plus a sibling close button outside the tab element; preserve the existing movement logic.

findings.trigger: Reach onboarding language, interaction mode, or Manual model profile choices with a keyboard and use arrow keys or Tab.
findings.actual: Custom role=radio buttons have aria-checked but no roving tabindex or arrow-key selection; every option is a separate Tab stop and arrows do nothing.
findings.expected: One group tab stop, selected-option roving focus, and arrow-key selection with Space/Enter activation.
findings.smallestFix: Use styled native radio inputs or add a shared roving-tabindex radio-group implementation.

findings.trigger: Open the Bigger Context details dialog from Settings and continue with Tab or Escape.
findings.actual: The element declares role=dialog and aria-modal=true but does not move or trap focus, close on Escape, or restore focus to the invoker; background controls remain keyboard-reachable.
findings.expected: Focus enters and stays in the dialog, Escape closes it, and focus returns to the Details control.
findings.smallestFix: Add open/close focus management, Escape handling, and a small focus loop for the switch and Close button.

findings.component: launcher/src/App.tsx:816-823 and launcher/src/i18n.ts:86 sidebar source action
findings.trigger: Activate the visible item labelled Source & credits.
findings.actual: The action opens the GitHub URL directly and provides no credits, attribution, license, or in-app source explanation.
findings.expected: The label and destination agree: either Source code opens GitHub, or Source & credits opens a credits/source surface with an explicit repository link.
findings.smallestFix: Rename the label to Source code for the current behavior, or add a minimal credits surface with the repository as a secondary link.
